title: 7 Major GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered
description: Following Rockstar's Netflix Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look, Polygon highlights the lingering questions fans still have about the cast and GTA Online.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Lingering Questions After the Latest GTA 6 Reveal

As the gaming community continues to dissect the latest media coverage surrounding Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster, attention has turned sharply toward what remains hidden. Following the extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 featured via Netflix, gaming outlet Polygon has pointed out that players are still left with several major, unanswered questions regarding the highly anticipated title.

While trailers and showcases provide stunning visuals and glimpses into the game's setting, they often leave core logistical and narrative elements shrouded in mystery. Major publications and fans alike are attempting to read between the lines, yet critical details about the project's structure are still under wraps.

## Cast Details and the Future of GTA Online

Among the top mysteries highlighted are fundamental aspects of the production, such as the full cast and the overarching direction for GTA Online. Who is officially in the cast, and how will their performances shape the narrative experience? Furthermore, the community is eager to learn what is happening with GTA Online, considering the massive legacy and ongoing success of its predecessor.

Rockstar has historically kept its cards close to its chest, revealing information in carefully calculated waves rather than all at once. Until the developer provides definitive answers, speculation will continue to run rampant across the gaming world.

## Editor's Take

Polygon's breakdown reminds us how effectively Rockstar manages the hype cycle. While the lack of concrete answers can be frustrating, it ultimately fuels the community's passion and ongoing speculation as we await further official updates.
